steps.what: Fit register headers between joists at the burned positions.
Run ducts to framed boxes; bath fan to RG-3.

benefits.value: 0.9 h saved on 7 register openings (about CAD 42)
benefits.detail: Assumes 12.0 min per register opening measured and cut on site versus 4.0 min with a labelled, pre-cut part, at CAD 46.2/h loaded. Replace with your own time study.

benefits.value: 6.1% cut waste vs 10% typical order allowance
benefits.detail: Acucut 1D nester on this trade's 14 sticks: 1 boards, 5.49 m stock for 5.15 m of parts (bundle-window constrained runs add about 0.5 points). Conventional allowance 5 to 15% (BuildingScience). Difference about 1 bf, CAD 1 at CAD 700/MBF (estimate).

FMI puts rework at about 5% of construction spend and 48% of rework on poor communication or data. If labelled, sequenced, pre-checked parts prevent 15 to 30% of this trade's rework (estimate), callbacks fall by 0.75 to 1.50% of trade spend. On the NAHB reference home (US$428,215 build, 6.3% share = US$26,978) that is US$202 to US$405; not scaled to the 96 m2 sample.

cell_does: Frames all 7 supply, return and exhaust openings from the model coordinates.
Burns the opening edges so the duct installer cuts the ceiling in one place.
cell_cannot: Size the system: CSA F280 heat loss and duct design stay with the HVAC designer.
app: MEP view: diffusers and returns on the plan.
Scan a header: terminal size and centre.
code: BCBC 9.32 (ventilation), 9.33 (heating), CSA F280 sizing; BCBC 9.23.5 for framing cuts
summary: Register and grille openings framed from the model's air terminal positions: blocking cut to the joist bay with the opening edges burned on it.
highlight: 7 registers and grilles framed from model coordinates (14 burned headers); no guessing where the diffuser lands.
routing: Acucut routing: the cell's nester groups this trade's parts by section and stock length, cuts them in bundle order (last-installed at the bottom), laser-burns the label, QR and every mark listed, and drops each bundle in its zone so the crew picks in install order.
